text.text_excerpt: Love this place! Been coming for years, and not tired of it yet. The pint and slice for $5 is a great deal. They also do multiple $2 shots every Friday. Nice way to kick off a fun weekend. The vibe in here is great. They have a digital jukebox. On the TVs they play sports games, movies, and even your favorite TV show if you want. The pizza is so yummy. It's simple and satisfying. They also hook it the hell up with toppings. If you order jalapeno you're gonna get enough for you and your entire family. Keep it up, NYP!

Came in with a small group after a dreary morning bike ride. And you know we hit up that $5 slice and a pint deal. I had a couple slices of meat lovers and I believe a Canebreak and a Bell's Two-Hearted Ale. The bartender was super friendly and chatty, and catered to our every whim. The pizza was greasy as you'd expect, and quite delicious. Typical NY style bar pizza. Cool little place.

We came here to watch a Packer game while we were in town. This place was nice. We were there at the same time as the Saints game and the bar was not overcrowed and we could sit and watch our own tv in the corner with the Pack on. They have a deal for $5, pizza slice and a pint. Would definitely stop by here again if we were in the area for a drink and maybe a game.
